billing.faq1A: Kusimbiswa kwekadhi kunodiwa pakunyoresa. Kuwana kwakazara kunopihwa kwemazuva manomwe pasina muripo. Mushure metrial, €120/mwedzi ichabhadharwa otomatiki. Kanzura mazuva manomwe asati apera kudzivirira kubhadhariswa.
billing.faq2A: Maplani ese anopa kuwana kwakazara kune zvese zviri mubasa. Enterprise inowedzerawo custom setup yebhizinesi rako uye managed social media pahukuru kuburikidza neAPI yedu (tinokubatsira kubata maakaunti).
billing.faq2Q: Musiyano uri pakati pePremium neEnterprise chii?
billing.faq3A: Unobatanidza maAPI keys ako emasevhisi ekunze (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude). TrendFlow inozvishandisa kugadzira vhidhiyo/voiceover/avatar. Unobhadhara masevhisi aya zvakananga pamitengo yavo.
billing.faq4A: Hongu, kutsvaga nekutsvaga kwetrend hakuna muganho pamaplani ePremium neEnterprise.
billing.faq5A: Hongu, chero nguva kubva pakadhi replan riri pamusoro. Auto-renewal ichadzimwa, uye kuwana kuchagara kusvika pakupera kwenguva yakabhadharwa.
billing.faq6A: Hongu. Isa promo code yako pamusoro; discount ichashanda pakunyoresa kuPremium kuburikidza neStripe.
billing.genApiBaseHint: Basic processing (editing, formatting, subtitles, Piper voiceover, export) inoshanda pasina external keys.
billing.genApiText: Muchikamu che 'Enterprise settings', batanidza makiyi ako emasevhisi anodiwa. TrendFlow ichabva yaashandisa kugadzira mavhidhiyo, voiceovers, avatars, uye kugadzirisa zvakananga mukati memapurojekiti ako emavhidhiyo. Unobhadhara masevhisi zvakananga pamitengo yavo, uye TrendTraffic inoita kuti zvose zvifambe.

billing.faq49Q1: Maitiro ekuyedza kwemazuva manomwe emahara anoshanda sei?
billing.faq49A1: Pakubhadhara unofanira kusimbisa kadhi rebhangi kuburikidza neStripe — zvinodiwa, asi hapana chinobhadhariswa kwemazuva manomwe uye unowana mukana uzere. Kana kuyedza kwapera, €49/mwedzi inobhadhariswa otomatiki. Kanzura mazuva manomwe asati apera uye hauzobhadhariswi zvachose.
billing.faq49A2: Autopilot shell: kutsvaga trends neanalytics, audience targeting, UGC studio, Chrome extension, Publisher ine content plan, autopilot neGallery. AI generation pachayo haina kusanganisirwa — inomhanya kuburikidza nekunyoresa kwako (Google Flow, NotebookLM, HeyGen) kana API keys dzako, uye unobhadhara vatengesi zvakananga pamitengo yavo.
billing.faq49A3: Vatengesi vanotengesa zvikwereti zvekubhadhara zvakachipa zvakanyanya pane masekonzi akafanana kuburikidza neAPI: Veo pakunyoresa kweGoogle AI yakachipa 2–10×, HeyGen avatars yakachipa anenge 3×. Uye NotebookLM haina API yeruzhinji zvachose — kunyoresa chete. Extension inoita kuti basa rishande mukati meakaundi ako, ichikupa nyore seAPI pamitengo yekubhadhara. Nhamba chaiyo dziri mutafura necalculator pamusoro.
billing.faq49A4: Maviri akakwana kutanga: Google AI Pro (€21.99/mwedzi — Flow vhidhiyo + NotebookLM ine miganhu yakakwirira) uye HeyGen Creator ($29/mwedzi — anenge maminitsi makumi matatu eAvatar IV). Basa rega rega rine miganhu yemahara (Flow — 50 credits/zuva, NotebookLM — 3 overviews/zuva, HeyGen — 3 mavhidhiyo/mwedzi), saka unogona kuyedza pipeline isina kunyoresa zvachose.
billing.faq49A5: Hongu. Batanidza keys dzako (Google Veo, FAL/Kling, Runway, OpenAI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Claude) muSettings uye basa rinogadzira nazvo zvakananga, hapana extension inodiwa. Unobhadhara mabasa iwayo pamitengo yavo. Nzira dzinovhengana zvakasununguka: avatars pakunyoresa, voice-over kuburikidza neAPI, semuenzaniso.
billing.faq49A6: Pamusoro peji rino, mu “Your plan” kadhi, bhatani re “Turn off auto-renewal” rinoonekwa kana subscription ichiri kushanda. Mari dzakabhadharwa hadzisi kudzoserwa, asi unogona kuramba uchishandisa kusvika nguva yapera. Kana ukadzima panguva ye trial, hauzobhadhariswa zvachose. Unogona kudzoka chero nguva usati wapera nguva.

billing.faq49A7: Hongu. Isa promo code pamusoro — discount inoshanda pa Premium checkout kuburikidza ne Stripe.

hotebook.privacyNote: Iyi iakaundi yako yeGoogle ine miganhu yako nemabhuku ako — hazvipindirani nevamwe vatengi. Akaunti yakaparadzana ine Google AI plan (Plus/Pro/Ultra) inokurudzirwa: miganhu yeNotebookLM yezuva nezuva (audio/video/chat) inoverengwa paakaundi. Iyo puratifomu haichengete makuki ako eGoogle — kupinda kwako kunoramba kuri mubrowser yako.

ttLanding.f1Text: Scan mapuratifomu matatu nenzvimbo nedunhu. "Audience targeting": tsanangura chigadzirwa chako — AI ichazadza vateereri otomatiki, sarudza mazwi akakosha mumitauro 29, uye tsvaga niches ine kudiwa chaiko. Makana evakwikwidzi muwatchlist ine nhoroondo yemametrics.
ttLanding.f2Text: Peta link kune chero TikTok, Instagram, kana YouTube vhidhiyo — Gemini ichaipatsanura frame neframe: hook, rhythm, structure, captions. Breakdown nemasubtitles zvichaenda kugalari, uye "TrendDNA" ichatungamira vhidhiyo yako yeramangwana otomatiki.
ttLanding.f3Text: Maitiro mana: solo, nhaurirano yevanhu vaviri, chinyorwa chako "sezvazviri", kutungamira kwakavakirwa pakuongorora kwetrend. HeyGen looks akagadzirira kana avatar kubva pamufananidzo wako, manzwi ese eElevenLabs kusanganisira clones, live subtitle styles, uye brand kits.
ttLanding.f4Text: Trend monitoring inoshandura zvawanikwa kuita mavhidhiyo akagadzirira akavakirwa patemplate yako. Auto-publishing chains inogovera mafomati otomatiki pamapuratifomu nemaslots — TikTok, YouTube, uye Instagram zvinogamuchira zvemukati panguva yakatarwa.

ttLanding.priceBody: Premium — kuwana kuzere kune ese mamodule. Mazuva 7 ekutanga mahara, hapana mari, kanda chero nguva.
ttLanding.savBody: Yedu yega Chrome extension inobatanidza masevhisi eAI uchishandisa masubscription ako aripo pachinzvimbo chekubhadhara kweAPI credit. Uye makiyi ako (BYOK) — Gemini, ElevenLabs, TikHub, Blotato — anoshanda zvakananga, pasina mari yepakati.
ttLanding.stBody: Kutsvaga mafambiro, kuongorora mavhidhiyo anopararira, maavatar, mazwi, zvinyorwa zvidiki, mavhidhiyo anogadzirwa otomatiki, uye kutumira otomatiki—zvese munzvimbo imwe chete. Batanidza makiyi ako ebasa kana kunyoresa uye ubhadhare nenzira inonyanya kudhura kwauri.
ttLanding.step1Text: Scanner yedu inovhara TikTok, Instagram, uye YouTube zvichibva paniche yako, dunhu, nemutauro. AI targeter yedu inoona micro-niches nemakiyi, ichiwarongedza nekudiwa chaiko.
ttLanding.step2Text: Gemini analytics inoparadzanisa mavhidhiyo anopararira kuita mahook, rhythm, uye chimiro. Unowana TrendDNA—recipe ye studio yako yevhidhiyo, pamwe nezvinyorwa zvidiki zvepakutanga.
ttLanding.step3Text: UGC studio yedu inogadzira mavhidhiyo eAI avatar: kutaridzika kwakagadzirira kana avatar kubva pamufananidzo wako, ElevenLabs mazwi mumitauro makumi maviri nepfumbamwe, cut-ins, zvinyorwa zvidiki, uye brand kit. Mafomati 9:16 uye 16:9.
ttLanding.step4Text: Autopilot inotarisa mafambiro uye inounganidza mavhidhiyo ichishandisa matemplate, ukuwo Publisher ichiwaronga kwemazuva makumi matatu neshanu mberi: 9:16 yeTikTok, 16:9 yeYouTube.
